title: CodeChef: Chef in Vaccination Queue
description: In a queue of people, array `arr` has 0 for a child (takes 1 minute) and 1 for an elderly person (takes 2 minutes). Chef is at 1-based position `p`. Find total minutes until Chef gets vaccinated.
constraints:
1 <= p <= len(arr) <= 100
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def queue_time(p: int, arr: list[int]) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def queue_time(p: int, arr: list[int]) -> int:
    return sum(2 if arr[i] == 1 else 1 for i in range(p))
explanation: Sums elapsed vaccination durations up to position p in O(p) time.
